name: bracket a unimodal optimum
mechanism: evaluate a unimodal function at two interior points of an interval, discard the outer third that cannot contain the optimum, and repeat until the interval is small

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Ternary search' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence search: a technique for finding the minimum or maximum of a function that is either strictly increasing and then strictly decreasing or vice versa

fails_when: multimodal functions bracket a local optimum silently
